tool_args.rationale: The archived two-layer siphon law with a signed square-root branch fits all five target-horizon rows with pilot RMSE about 1.9e-8. The fitted parameters imply a base amplitude of 7.702, sink inhibition of 0.698, and a positive square-root coefficient of 0.395. This supports fresh confirmation without another paid probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Even allowing the linear term either sign gives pilot RMSE 0.0148, whereas the square-root branch matches all five observations to rounding precision.
The pilot spans sink gradients from 0.25 to 2.20 and already distinguishes the branch form and sign.
The static siphon law matches the observations at the target horizon without introducing latent dynamics.
